name: cms
note: CMS Phase-2 step3, the whole detector and the physics objects: physics.json (jets, MET; the Physics domain, shared, where the event opens), hgcal.json, tracker.json, calo.json, pf.json and muon.json joined. Primary vertices move to the Physics domain. HGCalNanoAOD's GeneralTrack has the rows of Tracks (both are generalTracks in order): it is checked and folded into Tracks, which takes over its HGCal entry point (where a TICL candidate has no trackster it is drawn there), so candidate -> track and track <-> truth relations reach Tracks. Truth particles are drawn as helices; only in-time pile-up is kept (cuts from hgcal.json): particles of bunch crossing 0 and the vertices they are produced in or decay at (at PU200: 105k of 720k particles, 63k of 425k vertices per event). Domains: Physics, Tracker (with the field, from tracker.json), Calo (calo.json), HGCal (its region from the hits of the ttbar samples: r <= 257 cm, 322 <= |z| <= 513 cm), then Muons (r <= 760 cm, |z| <= 1080 cm, the chambers).
